Have a sleepover with a shelter dog

A night or a weekend in a home lets a shelter dog decompress and shows the shelter how they act in a house. Programs go by names like Slumber Party, Pawjama Party, Staycation, Sleepover Buddies and Weekend Warrior.

Good to know

Do I need to be a foster to host a sleepover?

Some shelters sign you up as a one-night foster on the spot; others ask you to complete a short foster application first. Each listing explains.

Can I bring the dog home if I have other pets?

Shelters usually ask you to keep the visiting dog separated from resident pets unless they have done a meet and greet.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.

Ready to adopt? ShelterAdoption, our sister site, lists every shelter near you plus upcoming adoption events.
